identity: SCRIPTURE - Gospel of Luke 16:19-17:37 in the Van Dyck Arabic Bible: the rich man and Lazarus, the sayings on stumbling-blocks and forgiveness, the mustard seed, the unprofitable servant, the ten lepers, the coming of the kingdom, and the days of the Son of Man. Six printed lines = six paragraph blocks. Third Luke passage in this corpus after doc_32d5d0cbc877 (which produced 0k) and doc_bd40f62e73c2.
law: THE VERSE IS THE UNIT (0k). 646 real tokens / 50 verses = 12.9 tokens per unit - identical to the figure measured on Luke 14-15 in the previous batch, which is a strong cross-check on the alignment. Inside a verse NOTHING cuts.
reasoning: Every trigger my PASS-2 rules own appears here and every one was suppressed. Imperatives: irhamni wa-arsil Liazar (16:24), udhkur (16:25), ihtarizu li-anfusikum ... fa-wabbikhhu ... fa-ghfir lahu (17:3, three imperatives in ONE verse), zid imanana (17:5), inqalii wa-ngharisi (17:6), taqaddam sarian wa-ttaki (17:7), adid ... wa-tamantaq wa-khdimni (17:8), fa-qulu (17:10), idhhabu wa-aru anfusakum (17:14), qum wa-mdi (17:19), la tadhhabu wa-la tatbau (17:23), udhkuru imraat Lut (17:32, a THREE-TOKEN verse standing alone). Speech announcers: fa-nada wa-qala, fa-qala Ibrahim, qala lahu Ibrahim, fa-ajaba Yasu wa-qala, fa-ajabu wa-qalu lahu - all keep their quotations (1v), and none of them is a boundary. bal at 16:21, 16:30 and 17:8; wa-lakin at 17:1 and 17:25; hatta inna at 16:26; li-anna at 16:28 and 17:24 - all sentence-internal. The alignment was checked at four risky points: 16:27/16:28 both end on words that recur (abi, hadha) and are resolved in sequence; 17:3 and 17:4 BOTH end on the identical two-token phrase fa-ghfir lahu, which is exactly the doc_bd40f62e73c2 lesson that identical wording can carry different verse divisions; 17:26-17:30 repeat kadhalika yakun aydan fi ayyam ibn al-insan and ahlaka al-jami twice each; and the source has a typo at @610 (innahu and fi run together as one token inhfi) which does not disturb the count. The last verse end lands exactly on the final token.
